title: Vilebone Maulclaws

infobox.Crafting Materials: Bear hide x3, Vile ribcage x3, Black metal x3, Linen thread x6

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Vilebone Maulclaws are the third fist weapon crafted from materials found in the Plains.
The primary attack is a 2-hit combo with 2x damage at the second hit. The secondary attack is a kick which does additional knockback and 6x staggering.
It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

Introduction. Vilebone Maulclaws are the third fist weapon crafted from materials found in the Plains.
The primary attack is a 2-hit combo with 2x damage at the second hit. The secondary attack is a kick which does additional knockback and 6x staggering.
